Scientific studies support that positive subliminal audios can help re-code your subconscious mind, which holds the majority of your mental energy. This makes them a valuable tool in your quest for success. In addition, binaural isochronic tones help usher your brain into an alpha state that boosts the absorption of these empowering messages.

For optimum benefits, listen for 30 minutes daily with headphones for at least 21 days. Whether you’re studying, walking, doing chores, or exercising, you can incorporate Shamanicca subliminals into your routine. Playing these audios while you sleep can further accelerate your progress.

To maximize the effect, try to reach a meditative state during your sessions and imagine your goal as if it has already been realized, amplifying the positive feelings. Individual results will differ, so some may see changes faster than others. Staying well-hydrated is also advised.

Subliminals Benefits:

  • Attracts money and abundance effortlessly.
  • Enhances belief in wealth and prosperity.
  • Opens the mind to great opportunities.
  • Creates a mindset of financial freedom.
  • Cultivates gratitude for prosperity.
  • Boosts self-worth and abundance consciousness.

Subliminal Positive affirmations in Shamanicca’s subliminals audios:

  • Wealth flows easily to me.
  • Abundance is my natural right.
  • I open myself to abundance.
  • I effortlessly attract wealth.
  • I have reached true financial freedom.
  • I am thankful for my riches.

  • I effortlessly create wealth.
